content.introduction: Oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9% with SK Hynix shares sinking by over 15% on a mixed day for Asian markets. SK Hynix's record $26bn IPO from its US listing boosted markets across Asia. Meanwhile, India is likely exporting refined Russian oil to the West, matching its rising Russian oil imports. The Nikkei 225 Index dropped 0.33%, the Hang Seng Index rose 0.57%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.82%, the BSE SENSEX Index climbed 1.62%, and the FTSE Straits Times Index declined 0.65%.
